description: This file contains unit tests for the ClientRepository class in the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM system. It verifies the retrieval of client entities and validation of client credentials, focusing on different client configurations and states.

classes.name: ClientRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ClientRepository's methods, including client retrieval and validation logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by loading data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetClientEntity
methods.description: Tests retrieval of client entities by ID, asserting properties like name, redirect URI, confidentiality, and display name.

methods.name: testValidateClient
methods.description: Tests validation of client credentials, checking different edge cases including non-existent, disabled, and confidential clients.
